speak.yaml:
name: "谁是卧底 第1轮 发言"
metadata:
  description: "存活玩家按座位顺序各说一句话描述自己的词语"
participants:
  seat1:
    display_name: "1号 玩家1"
    required: true
  seat3:
    display_name: "3号 玩家3"
    required: true
  seat4:
    display_name: "4号 玩家4"
    required: true
  seat5:
    display_name: "5号 玩家5"
    required: true
  seat6:
    display_name: "6号 玩家6"
    required: true
  referee:
    display_name: "主持人"
    required: true
runtime:
  kind: state_machine
  state_machine:
    version: 1
    graph_mode: acyclic
    defaults:
      node_timeout_ms: 420000
      max_attempts: 1
    nodes:
      speak_open:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "回合开场"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: referee
        node_timeout_ms: 900000
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [speak_1, speak_2, speak_3, speak_4, speak_5, speak_6]
      speak_1:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "1号发言"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: seat1
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [speak_2, speak_3, speak_4, speak_5, speak_6, collect]
      speak_2:
        kind: human_input
        display_name: "👤 你的发言（2号 · 人类玩家）"
        node_timeout_ms: 900000
        instruction: |
          【你的词语】隐词甲

          第 1 轮 · 你是 2 号 · 轮到你发言了。
          上面能看到本轮在你之前的人说了什么。

          写一句话（不超过 25 个字）描述你的词，别把这个词说出来，也别拆开来说。
          说钝一点：这句话得能同时套在至少 4 样别的东西上。
          别提身份、别点评别人，只说你的词。

          [UNDERCOVER_UI_CONTEXT_V1]
          {"action":"speech","round":1,"seatNumber":2,"word":"隐词甲","maxChars":25,"forbidOwnWord":true,"bluntness":4}
          [/UNDERCOVER_UI_CONTEXT_V1]
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [speak_3, speak_4, speak_5, speak_6, collect]
      speak_3:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "3号发言"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: seat3
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [speak_4, speak_5, speak_6, collect]
      speak_4:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "4号发言"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: seat4
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [speak_5, speak_6, collect]
      speak_5:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "5号发言"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: seat5
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [speak_6, collect]
      speak_6:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "6号发言"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: seat6
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [collect]
      collect:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "本轮发言汇总"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: referee
        node_timeout_ms: 600000
        final_output: true
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>

tab.title: 谁是卧底 · 第 1 轮发言

vote.yaml:
name: "谁是卧底 第1轮 投票"
metadata:
  description: "存活玩家根据全部发言并行投票，主持人计票"
participants:
  seat1:
    display_name: "1号 玩家1"
    required: true
  seat3:
    display_name: "3号 玩家3"
    required: true
  seat4:
    display_name: "4号 玩家4"
    required: true
  seat5:
    display_name: "5号 玩家5"
    required: true
  seat6:
    display_name: "6号 玩家6"
    required: true
  referee:
    display_name: "主持人"
    required: true
runtime:
  kind: state_machine
  state_machine:
    version: 1
    graph_mode: acyclic
    defaults:
      node_timeout_ms: 420000
      max_attempts: 1
    nodes:
      vote_open:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "开投"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: referee
        node_timeout_ms: 900000
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [vote_1, vote_2, vote_3, vote_4, vote_5, vote_6]
      vote_1:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "1号投票"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: seat1
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [tally]
      vote_2:
        kind: human_input
        display_name: "👤 你的投票（2号 · 人类玩家）"
        node_timeout_ms: 900000
        instruction: |
          【你的词语】隐词甲

          第 1 轮投票 · 你是 2 号。
          大家说过的话，主持人刚在群里念过一遍。

          可以投的人：1号、3号、4号、5号、6号，不能投自己。
          只写「我投N号」，N 是阿拉伯数字，不用写理由。
          不想投就写「我弃权」。

          [UNDERCOVER_UI_CONTEXT_V1]
          {"action":"vote","round":1,"seatNumber":2,"word":"隐词甲","allowAbstain":true}
          [/UNDERCOVER_UI_CONTEXT_V1]
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [tally]
      vote_3:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "3号投票"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: seat3
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [tally]
      vote_4:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "4号投票"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: seat4
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [tally]
      vote_5:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "5号投票"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: seat5
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [tally]
      vote_6:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "6号投票"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: seat6
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
        transitions:
          complete:
            targets: [tally]
      tally:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: "开票"
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: referee
        node_timeout_ms: 600000
        final_output: true
        instruction: |
          <BOT_INSTRUCTION>
